products.product_description: Buttermilk Pancake and Waffle Mix, Item number: 6170B25, packaged in 25 lbs. bulk kraft bag. The label is read in parts: "***BUTTERMILK PANCAKE & WAFFLE MIX***Net Wt 25 LB *** INGREDIENTS: Organic Whole Grain Buckwheat Flour, Organic Stone Ground Whole Wheat Pastry Flour, Wheat Gluten, Cane Sugar, Baking Powder (Monocalcium Phosphate, Sodium Bicarbonate, Cornstarch), Sea Salt***Manufactured in a facility that also uses tree nuts, soy, wheat and milk***.

products.reason_for_recall: Buttermilk Pancake and Waffle Mix is recalled due to undeclared milk in the ingredients statement. The ingredients statement of Buckwheat Pancake and Waffle Whole Grain Mix and the nutritional label was mistakenly applied to packages of Buttermilk Pancake and Waffle Mix.
